Blackwave Code: Togetherness- Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor- Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: Accountability- Digitize quality: Establish a digital QMS platform as the mandatory system of record, with quality documentation and workflows fully migrated and adopted across the organization. Blackwave Code: PlayfulnessYOUR PROFILE- 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office- Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management- Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end- Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy- Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity- Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator- Fluent English is a must; German is a plusWHAT WE OFFER- Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.- Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.- Coffee Culture @ Blackwave: Enjoy premium coffee from our portafilter machine or join one of our barista courses.- Choose Your Perk: Select from a Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a Give Card.- Gear up for Take-off: Receive premium Blackwave team apparel during your on boarding.- Grow in Aerospace: Expand your professional horizons in a high-growth company at the forefront of space technology.- Rooftop Relaxation: End your day on our spacious rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Alps.Please refer to reference number YF-51680 for your application.Apply for this job
